title: Townsend Brown crash retrievals and green fireball

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a story about a man named Townsend Brown. Michels says that in the late 1950s and early 1960s Brown would go out into the field in the United States, show official credentials, and recover crashed objects, what people in this world call crash retrievals. According to Michels, Brown found a "green fireball", a glowing green ball of light, that was losing mass, and it was apparently made of barium titanate, a ceramic compound, which would suggest hidden recoveries of unknown material if true.
